title: Typographic / Editorial Identity Independence
question: Can Kymaean carry recognizable shared-brand character across an expressive public-web context and a restrained app-like utility context through typographic/editorial behavior when existing mark-lockup, palette/material cues, imagery, Quiet-Stage composition, relational traces, hero geometry and motion are removed as identity carriers?
scope_interpretation: This is a deliberately strong identity-independence screen. It tests transferable typographic/editorial grammar before any typeface selection. A failure does not prove typography cannot contribute to Kymaean identity; it proves the tested grammar cannot carry the required identity burden under these isolation conditions.

authority.drive_wordmark_evidence: Kymaean Lane B — Bespoke Wordmark Construction 02.md

external_accessibility_snapshot.usage_note: WCAG 2.2 is the measurement reference for web specimens. WCAG2ICT is transfer guidance for the app-like specimen only; this experiment does not claim native Windows accessibility certification.

floors.text_resize: 200% without loss of content or functionality
floors.reflow: 320 CSS px equivalent without two-dimensional scrolling except essential two-dimensional content

non_authority: The fixture copy is measurement text, not final website or product copy and does not freeze product terminology.
No reference typeface, font family, weight, optical size or specimen value becomes a final typography selection.
No family in this matrix is a final identity family or a Phase-C convergence decision.
This contract creates no image-generation, renderer-spend, app-implementation, website-production, deployment or motion authority.
O3 and Threshold K remain outside the scored specimens; this experiment neither redesigns nor extends them into a typography system.

hypotheses.H1: A transferable typographic/editorial grammar can remain recognizably one family across expressive-web and restrained app-like contexts without non-typographic brand carriers.
hypotheses.H2: The same grammar can adapt its degree of expression without becoming two unrelated surface-specific systems.
hypotheses.H3: A first strong-independence survivor does not require bespoke glyph drawing, brand-name recognition, decorative display typography or face-specific novelty.
hypotheses.null: If web/app pairing, product-truth fit, readability or genericity resistance fails under the frozen isolation contract, TYP-01 strong independence does not survive.

scored_specimens_must_omit: the words KYMÆAN, Kymaean and Ensemble
any symbol, logo or app icon
icons, diagrams, visible rules or explanatory geometry
gradients, textures, shadows or material effects

neutral_surface.note: Measurement neutrals only; no palette authority.

reference_typeface_policy.rule: Resolve one ordinary host-provided neutral sans/system UI face mechanically before specimen construction and use the exact same computed face for every family, control, context and viewport.
record_required: computed font style and available weights
reference_typeface_policy.invalid_if: Any specimen resolves to a materially different computed family or substitutes a custom/bespoke/downloaded face.
reference_typeface_policy.authority_note: The resolved face is a fixture carrier only and gains no selection authority.

allowed_variables: allocation of emphasis among the frozen content blocks
isolation.forbidden_rescue: No copy rewrite, added label, icon, color, shape, rule, image, custom glyph, brand name, mark, material effect or context-specific decorative device may be added to improve a weak family after construction.

content_packet.immutability: Every scored specimen uses these six strings in this order with identical words and punctuation.

blocks.text: What happens changes what can happen next.
A persistent Production carries people, circumstances, and accepted consequence forward.
Current scene — A decision is waiting.
Known here — Mara knows the invitation was withdrawn. Iven does not.
Committed consequence — The east passage is closed.
Possible next — Ask for another route.

fixed_rules: text only on the neutral surface
family may use whitespace and measure for expression but may not change content order or wording
text only on the neutral surface
no navigation, cards, icons or application chrome
family may reduce expressive scale/spacing only through its frozen APP adaptation rule

context_contracts.frame_note: Reference frames are experimental canvases, not production viewport/window requirements.

CNEG.name: Neutral Utility negative control
CNEG.purpose: Readable generic hierarchy with intentionally low identity burden.

CPOS.name: Cross-context pairing calibration positive control
CPOS.purpose: Deliberately obvious synthetic grammar used only to verify that reviewers can perform the pairing task; excluded from Kymaean scoring.

vector.P1: 3.0u / weight 650 when available else nearest available weight / line-height 1.00
vector.spacing: 2.4u major gap after P2; 0.8u inside utility sequence

F1.name: Quiet Structure
F1.mechanism: Identity through proportion, restrained spacing hierarchy and low-frequency emphasis rather than ornament.

vector.spacing: 0.75u within related label/value blocks; 1.5u normal block gap; 2.5u after P2

F2.name: Dramatic Cadence
F2.mechanism: Identity through sequence and pause: controlled shifts in scale and vertical silence make consequence feel temporal without motion.

vector.P3-P6: values 1.18u / 550 when available else nearest available weight / line-height 1.30; labels 0.82u / 500 / sentence case
vector.spacing: 2.8u after P2; 1.2u after P3; 2.2u after P4; 1.2u after P5

F2.primary_risk: generic magazine/theater pacing or spectacle without product meaning

F3.name: Human-State Counterpoint
F3.mechanism: Identity through a stable two-register editorial counterpoint: lived/knowledge language receives restrained human modulation while current world-state language remains upright and exact.

vector.P3,P5,P6: values 1.0u / 550 when available else nearest available weight / upright / line-height 1.35
vector.P3-P6 labels: 0.74u / 650 when available else nearest available weight / uppercase / tracking +0.06em / upright

F3.primary_risk: semantic coding masquerading as identity, literary affect, or visual implication that typography itself changes authority

F4.name: Compression / Release
F4.mechanism: Identity through a repeatable contrast between a spacious explanatory opening and a compact but legible present-state sequence.

vector.P1: 2.5u / 650 when available else nearest available weight / line-height 1.05 / tracking -0.015em

F4.primary_risk: generic product-editorial/SaaS hierarchy or loss of human character under utility compression

context_adaptation.principle: Family mechanism, content order, type-register relationships and emphasis ordering are invariant. Context changes magnitude, never grammar.

REFLOW_320.size_reduction: none beyond the APP context multiplier already defined

matrix.generation_rule: Generate exactly one specimen for every ordered family × context × viewport tuple. Every specimen consumes CP-01 unchanged, the named family/control vector, the named context contract and the applicable adaptation multipliers. No additional specimens are scored.

required: one deterministic local text-only HTML specimen harness under prototypes/typ-01/
one machine-readable manifest enumerating all 24 specimen IDs and computed reference-face metadata
one source hash record covering the frozen contract, harness and manifest
wide and 320px deterministic views for structural/accessibility preflight
a blinded reviewer packet generated from the same source without modifying specimen styling
prohibited: screenshots used as substitute authority for source
candidate-specific styling corrections after scoring begins

must_pass_before_blinding: all 24 specimen IDs exist exactly once
all specimens contain CP-01 byte-identical visible strings in P1-P6 order
computed reference face is identical across all specimens
normal and large text contrast floors are met
200% text resize produces no content/function loss
320px reflow produces no horizontal scrolling or clipped text
WCAG text-spacing stress values produce no clipping, overlap or content loss
APP P3-P6 remain visually distinguishable as a scannable sequence
WEB and APP preserve each family's declared invariant emphasis relationships
preflight.failure_consequence: Correct only mechanical implementation deviations from this frozen contract. A correction that changes a family mechanism or scoring law requires method reopening before evaluation.

freeze_before_review: mapping key from real family IDs to blinded IDs
blinding_and_review.blinding: Assign independent opaque labels to the six WEB families and six APP families. Preserve the mapping key outside reviewer-visible material. Reviewer-visible packets must not contain F1-F4/CNEG/CPOS names, mechanism descriptions or project-history provenance.
blinding_and_review.independence_rule: The construction author cannot be the sole deciding reviewer. At least one review record must come from a human Director or other independent visual reviewer, and final survivor status may not be established entirely inside the same construction context.
tasks: Pair each WEB specimen with the APP specimen that appears to belong to the same visual family at WIDE.
Repeat the pairing independently at REFLOW_320.
For every proposed pair, score the frozen dimensions without seeing the mapping key.

distinctiveness.2: clear non-ornamental character that remains identifiable across contexts

product_truth_fit.0: implies chat, technical dashboard, spectacle, false authority or unrelated luxury/editorial semantics
product_truth_fit.2: supports persistence, human consequence and changing possibility without exposing backend structure

web_expression.2: strong public-facing expression without spectacle dependence

app_utility.2: quiet, immediate and robust for utility reading

readability.0: hierarchy or reading is materially unclear
readability.2: immediately legible hierarchy and comfortable reading

control_validity.CPOS: At least 2 of 3 reviewers must correctly pair CPOS at both WIDE and REFLOW_320. Otherwise the review session is invalid and no family result is recorded.
control_validity.CNEG: CNEG should remain readable while carrying low distinctiveness. If a majority gives CNEG distinctiveness=2 and product_truth_fit=2, the session is treated as non-discriminating and no family result is recorded.
control_validity.non_compensation: A valid CPOS cannot rescue a failed family and a weak CNEG cannot lower a family threshold. Controls validate the review procedure only.

hard_failures: A family can be identified only because an excluded mark, name, color, material, image, icon, rule, geometry or motion cue leaked into the specimen.
WEB and APP require different grammar rather than the frozen adaptation of one grammar.
APP ordinary reading or scanning is materially impaired by the identity treatment.
The family depends on a decorative display treatment that does not survive the APP or 320px condition.
A majority reads the family primarily as generic luxury editorial, generic AI futurism, generic SaaS/product, generic Windows system or decorative theater.
The family visually implies that typography itself changes canon/authority or turns internal architecture into the visible aesthetic.
Fixture words/order are changed to rescue identity or hierarchy.
Reviewer-visible material leaks family names, mechanism descriptions or the mapping key before scoring is complete.

required: at least 2 of 3 reviewers correctly pair the WEB and APP member at WIDE
at least 2 of 3 reviewers correctly pair the WEB and APP member at REFLOW_320
family_pass_rule.genericity_rule: The family fails if a majority selects any one prohibited genericity category. kymaean_specific and none_of_these are not prohibited categories.
family_pass_rule.non_compensating: Scores are conjunctive. Strong web expression cannot compensate for weak app utility, weak pairing, genericity, readability or accessibility.

termination.initial_family_pack: Exactly F1-F4 plus CNEG/CPOS controls. No fifth family is added inside this method after results are visible.
termination.post_judgment_refinement: None. After blinded scoring begins, no scored family may be visually refined or rerolled inside TYP-01.
termination.mechanical_correction: One correction pass is allowed only if preflight or review proves the implementation deviated from frozen source rules. The correction must restore the frozen rule rather than improve the mechanism, and the full affected review must restart blinded.
termination.zero_survivors: Close TYP-01 strong-independence as failed under this contract. Do not reopen hero research. Return to a fresh Phase-B orthogonal shared-brand question audit.
termination.one_survivor: Record one viable typographic/editorial identity mechanism. Phase B remains non-converged and no font/system is selected.
termination.two_or_more_survivors: Promote at most the two strongest materially distinct surviving mechanisms as Phase-B evidence. This does not by itself satisfy the roadmap's broader two-family convergence prerequisite or authorize Phase C.

next_action_after_method_adoption: Materialize the deterministic text-only static specimen harness and manifest under prototypes/typ-01/ from this exact contract; freeze computed reference-face metadata and source hashes; run structural/accessibility preflight before any blinded scoring.
hard_boundary: No image generation, generative renderer use/spend, final font/typeface/typography system, final identity or hero, O3/Threshold-K redesign, palette/material reopening, Quiet-Stage/hero refinement, app implementation, website production/deployment or transcript-dependent Stage motion.

checks: no convergence or implementation authority inflation
recursive_audit.approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION — CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT.
